title: Portrait / 人像
input_provenance: AI-generated fictional adult, not based on a real person
workflow: Generated the input image first, then edited that exact image using referenced_image_paths.

before.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create an original editorial portrait photograph of a fictional woman in her mid-forties for a public art demonstration. She is not based on any real or famous person. Portrait 4:5, head and shoulders, the whole top of the hair visible with a small amount of breathing room above. Her shoulders turn gently toward the right side of the image, while her face turns back in a three-quarter view toward the camera. A direct, thoughtful, quietly self-possessed gaze. Natural individual features: short dark espresso bob with a slightly asymmetrical fringe, one side tucked behind the visible ear; prominent cheekbones, softly angular jaw, a straight distinctive nose, scattered natural freckles across the nose and cheeks, slight lines around the eyes, relaxed closed lips with a subtle natural asymmetry. Brown eyes with small believable catchlights. One plain tiny silver hoop in the visible ear. Do not beautify or smooth the skin. A simple matte black fine-knit turtleneck frames her neck and shoulders.

The backdrop is a seamless deep vermilion red, a dense matte pigment red rather than fluorescent. Restrained directional soft daylight from image left gives gentle dimensionality and real skin texture, with the far cheek in soft shade. Clear silhouette, rich restrained color, modern independent fashion-magazine photography, tactile and unretouched. A strong intimate image without theatrical sadness, smile posing, elaborate styling or excessive glamour. Eye-level medium-telephoto perspective, crisp focus on eyes and near cheek, realistic hair. The person fills roughly three quarters of the frame height, shoulders naturally cropped by the lower edge. No hands, props, flowers, text, logo, watermark, borders or graphical layout. Output only the single full-frame color photograph.

after.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / style-transfer. Edit the supplied fictional portrait photograph into a finished Soul Imprint artwork: selective graphite-transfer impressions on luminous white paper. The supplied photo is the sole identity and composition reference. Keep exactly the same person, age, facial proportions, asymmetrical short bob, ear and tiny hoop, freckles, direction of gaze, relaxed lips, head angle, shoulder posture and 4:5 framing. Do not invent a new face or beautify, age, smooth, or change the expression. This is one image, not a before-and-after layout.

Replace the complete photographic rendering with a purposeful constellation of material impressions. Keep the eyes, near eyebrow, a short edge of the nose, the line between the lips, a few distinctive freckles and the contour of the visible ear accurately recognizable. These accents can be crisp mid-to-dark graphite. Face planes become mostly unmarked white paper with only the minimum silvery-grey broken impressions needed to retain her likeness. Use granular contact-like deposits and interrupted ink-transfer-like fragments, never conventional cross-hatching or a fully shaded pencil portrait. Do not outline the face continuously. Genuinely omit portions of the outer cheek and lower neck contour while preserving facial identity.

Translate the dark hair into a few bold irregular graphite islands that retain the asymmetric silhouette and the visible parting. Separate those islands with convincing thin empty fissures and some soft missing patches aligned with the hair flow. Preserve recognizable hair geometry without drawing every strand. Let the outermost hair wisps disappear selectively into the page. Keep enough deep graphite in one portion of the fringe to create a decisive focal contrast with the white face. The black turtleneck becomes several broken textile-like contact traces close to the neck; the lower shoulders recede almost completely into white. This should create a beautiful transition from the clear living gaze to increasingly incomplete material presence, not a uniformly faded picture.

The entire red background is replaced by quiet fresh neutral-white thin kozo paper. Sparse minute fibers visible only on close inspection. One or two very faint handling creases confined to the outer blank margins; no creases crossing the face. Paper fills the frame like a direct art reproduction. Slight pressure variation within marks, some dry granular edges, clean untouched gaps. Deep graphite, silver-grey and white only. Large blank areas stay luminous and clean, without global dirt or wrinkle overlay.

Emotional tone: poised, alert, intimate and alive, with the same self-possessed expression as the photograph. Form is partially withdrawn while the person's presence remains strong. Avoid ghost faces, medical or death-mask imagery, charcoal smears across the eyes, sepia, antique stains, arbitrary grunge, vector tracing, full photographic greyscale conversion, beautification, melodrama or heavy opaque clothing masses. No added text, signature, labels, frame, art supplies, hands or tabletop. Make this an artistically compelling high-resolution graphite-transfer portrait whose selective absences are as deliberate as its crisp surviving details.
